source_text: Moyses Aethiopissam duxit uxorem; Maria et Aaron detraxerunt. Maria leprosa efficitur. Maria formam prioris populi habet; Moyses legem; Aethiopissa ecclesiam ex gentibus. Synagoga indignatur de uxore ex gentibus. Maria eicitur extra castra; lepra peccati apparet cum nubes gratiae recesserit.
pass_a_gloss: Moses Cushite led wife; Miriam and Aaron spoke-against. Miriam leprous is-made. Miriam form of-prior people has; Moses law; Cushite church from nations. Synagogue is-indignant concerning wife from nations. Miriam is-cast outside camps; leprosy of-sin appears when cloud of-grace will-have-withdrawn.
pass_b_english: [[Moses had taken a Cushite wife; Miriam and Aaron spoke against him >> Bible:Numbers 12:1]]. Miriam becomes leprous. Miriam figures the former people; Moses the law; the Cushite the church from the nations. The synagogue is offended at the wife from the Gentiles. Miriam is put outside the camp; the leprosy of sin appears when the cloud of grace withdraws.
